memory_bridge: At one exhibit, 現在（げんざい） marks what is present now; the hidden jade 現れる（あらわれる） by itself, while the curator 現す（あらわす） it deliberately.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 現在（げんざい）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: A placard says the jade is on display 現在（げんざい）—at present. The common time word anchors On ゲン without the phonetically inaccurate GEM cue.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 現れる（あらわれる）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: The hidden jade 現れる（あらわれる）—appears—when the cover falls away by itself. This is the intransitive event.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 現す（あらわす）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: A curator deliberately 現す（あらわす） the jade—reveals or represents it. This is the transitive action.

memory_bridge: A needle makes one journey through the cloth: while it passes, guò falls out the far side in 过去; afterward, only a light guo experience-tag remains stitched to the event.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 过去 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: The needle travels 过去 through every inch of cloth, then drops out the far side; guò falls with the completed passage.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 过 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: Once the needle has been through, a tiny 过 tag remains to mark the experience; guo is light and neutral because the journey is backgrounded.
